items.question: How many PTO days do employees with 0-2 years of service get?
items.evidence:
Paid time off at Contoso is based on years of service:
- 0-2 years: 15 days per year
- 3-5 years: 20 days per year
- 6+ years: 25 days per year
items.answer: Employees with 0-2 years of service get 15 PTO days per year.
items.label: supported

items.question: How long do I have to submit an expense?
items.evidence:
1. Collect all receipts.
2. Submit through the Contoso Expense Portal within 30 days.
3. Attach scanned or photographed receipts.
4. Manager approval is required within 5 business days.
5. Reimbursement is processed in the next payroll cycle.
items.answer: Submit it through the Expense Portal within 30 days.
